text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Accepting an invitation from Ryoka 
Tsurugi, I visited the tour of the finals 
venue alongside <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scale of the stadium was utterly 
magnificent, and imagining an excitement 
distinct from the fervor of the racetrack 
filled everyone with rising anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sonon Elfie and Ryoka Tsurugi— their dream 
has finally come true. Their bond and 
passion are what made the "U.A.F." grow 
this big.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking new entertainment and further 
possibilities for sports, the two pledged 
to continue walking together from here on 
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the tour, <chrname> and the others are 
stopped by Sonnet Elfie. As their greatest 
rival, she declares war once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make the year-end finals the best they 
can possibly be. Vowing to give it their 
all, they head into the finals!
